item.description: ### Fixed - **The phone now says why a composer vanished.** Kill an agent while its terminal pane stays open and the reply field on the iPhone disappears — as it must — but the screen said nothing about why. Perch now checks that the agent's process is really gone and tells the phone "The agent is no longer running here," in the moment you were most likely mid-reply. Sending was always refused in this state; only the explanation was missing. - **Three rare crashes-in-waiting are gone.** Moving the whole codebase to Swift 6's concurrency checking surfaced three long-standing data races — in the socket server's shutdown, the network listener's lifecycle, and the push retry path — all fixed. Nothing you see changes; the app is simply built to a stricter standard now.
